Sara — attaching our draft materials and a brief answers sheet inline. Sending the CSV dataflow as a separate attachment (technical-transfer-map-v1.csv).

Inline answers (short):
1) Transfer legal basis: Redwood supports SCCs (2021 Clauses) in our DPA annex by default; for customers requesting DPF equivalent evidence we provide a supplemental controls pack (DESCRIBED in the draft annex) and we will complete any additional attestation to the extent of our remit as a processor. We do not assert a unilateral DPF adequacy; we provide documented mitigations and vendor assessments that support customers that must rely on DPF or SCC+supplemental measures.

2) Keys: Redwood offers both Redwood-managed KMS and customer-managed keys (CMK) via cloud KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). For hosted customers by default keys are in the region where the tenant is configured; our logs and ephemeral cache material do not persist encryption keys. HSM-backed keywrap operations are available for Dedicated and Private deployments.

3) Logs & retention: Audit logs for privileged actions are retained in an append-only store for 24 months by default; we can extend retention on request. Tamper-evidence is provided via chained checksums and a write-once log store for regulated customers if required.

Attachments: redwood-dpa-annex-draft.pdf; technical-transfer-map-v1.csv

Thanks — Laura
